text: Riya poochhti hai. Sir, agar government servant service ke dauraan mar jaaye, to office ko sabse pehle kya karna chahiye, aur kaunse letters jaate hain? Namaste! Batch 6 shuru karte hain — CCS Pension Rules do hazaar ikkis ka aakhri lamba hissa. Aaj Rules ikehattar se sattasi: service ke dauraan death, pensioner ki death ya missing hona, pension ka payment, aur aakhirkar unnis sau bahattar ke purane rules ka repeal. Yeh sirf explanation hai, aur batch ke end mein chhota recap milega. Chaliye, Riya ka pehla sawaal sunte hain. Shuruaat Head of Office se hoti hai. Death ki khabar milte hi woh decide karta hai ki death gratuity deni hai, family pension deni hai, ya dono. Yeh clarity aage ka poora case aasan bana deti hai. Gratuity ke liye pehle nomination check hota hai. Agar nomination nahi hai, ya woh ab valid nahi hai, to Head of Office decide karta hai ki kaun entitled hai. Phir Format 11 ka letter jaata hai aur claim Form 9 mein maanga jaata hai. Family pension ke liye letter Format 12 mein jaata hai, eligible family member ya guardian ke naam. Claim Form 10 mein aata hai, saath mein bank undertaking Format 9. Dhyan rakhiye, Format 9 aur Form 9 do bilkul alag cheezein hain. Ek example. Dev Rao ki death hui aur koi nomination nahi thi. Head of Office ne heirs ko Format 11 bheja aur widow ko Format 12. Trap yeh hai ki Rule 71 mein chhe sub-rules hain, chaar nahi. Aur Form, Format se alag hota hai.
Yaad rakhiye: gratuity ke liye Format 11 jaata hai aur claim Form 9 mein aata hai. Family pension ke liye Format 12 aur Form 10.

Riya poochhti hai. Sir, agar employee government quarter mein rehta tha, to death ke baad licence fee aur damages ka kya hota hai? Agar servant government quarter mein rehta tha, to death se pehle ka licence fee maaf ho jaata hai. Matlab family se purana rent nahi maanga jaayega. Yeh waiver seedha Rule 71(4)(a) se aata hai. Lekin damages maaf nahi hote. Damages yani bina permission rehne ka penalty charge, aur woh death gratuity se kaata jaata hai. Haan, agar family quarter retain karti hai, to death ke mahine aur uske baad teen mahine ka fee nahi liya jaata. Teesra clause ek clock lagata hai. Head of Office ko intimation milne ke saat din ke andar Directorate of Estates ko likhna hota hai, taaki No Demand Certificate mil sake. Letter late hua to recovery ka jhagda baad tak chalta hai. Charu Nair ki death 12 August ko hui, office ko 14 August ko pata chala, to letter 21 August tak jaana chahiye. Family ne quarter rakha, to August se November tak fee nahi. Trap: fee maaf hai, damages nahi. Yaad rakhiye: death se pehle ka fee maaf, damages nahi, death ka mahina aur teen mahine free, aur letter saat din mein.

Riya poochhti hai. Agar employee dead nahi, missing hai, to kya hota hai? Claims kab maange ja sakte hain? Ab missing ka case. Servant gayab hai, death certificate nahi hai. Rule 71(5) kehta hai ki Rule 51 ke sub-rule ek aur chaar ke hisaab se dekho ki gratuity ya family pension banti hai ya nahi. Claims tabhi maange jaate hain jab police report ho — FIR, Daily Diary Entry ya General Diary Entry — aur police ka untraced report bhi. Bina report claim maangna jaldi karna hai, aur woh file wapas aayegi. Missing case mein claim ke saath Format 9 undertaking, Format 8 ka indemnity bond, aur dono police reports lagti hain. Aur Head of Office death certificate ka intezaar nahi karta — credible information par action shuru kar deta hai. Trap yeh hai ki missing aur death ek jaisa nahi hai. Police report hi trigger hai. Aur yaad rakhiye, Rule 71 mein chhe sub-rules hain, isliye 71(5) aur 71(6) ko chhodna nahi chahiye. Yaad rakhiye: missing servant matlab Rule 51, police report pehle, aur Format 8 ka indemnity bond.

Riya poochhti hai. Sir, Rules 71 se 80 mein itne Forms aur Formats hain. Kaun kiska hai? Formats sarkari letters aur bonds hote hain. Format 8 missing case ka indemnity bond, Format 9 bank undertaking, Format 10 covering letter, Format 11 gratuity ka letter, Format 12 family pension ka letter, aur Format 13 family pension ka sanction. Forms claims aur records hote hain. Form 3 common nomination — gratuity, GPF aur insurance ke liye. Form 9 gratuity claim, Form 10 family pension claim, Form 11 poora case file, Form 12 death certificate ke saath claim, Form 13 residuary gratuity. Purane rhyme par bharosa mat kijiye ki aath, nau evidence hain. Form 8 spouse ka request hai, Format 8 indemnity bond. Aur Form A retirees ke liye Form 6-A se replace ho gaya, gyarah September 2024 ke Office Memorandum se. Ek hi number, do alag kagaz. Format 13 family pension sanction karta hai, Form 13 residuary gratuity ka claim hai. Format 9 undertaking hai, Form 9 gratuity claim. Exam mein pehle poochhiye — Form hai ya Format? Yaad rakhiye: aath se terah tak rhyme se mat sikhiye. Poochhiye Form hai ya Format, aur Form 6 ab Form 6-A hai.

Riya poochhti hai. Death case mein marhoom ki service kaise check hoti hai, aur bada relief kya hai? Death case mein service book poora dekha jaata hai, sirf Rule 30 ke baad ka hissa nahi. Head of Office ko satisfy hona chahiye ki poori service ke verification certificates record mein hain. Aur yahi bada relief hai. Jo service verify nahi hui, woh service book ke entries ke aadhaar par verified maan li jaati hai. Family ko bahar se proof dhoondhne nahi bheja jaata. Do aur limbs. Officer chahe to koi bhi relevant material, jo usko ready access mein mile, use kar sakta hai — yeh power hai, duty nahi. Lekin use dekhna hoga ki service continuous thi aur dismissal, removal, resignation ya strike se forfeit nahi hui. Dev Rao ke do saal ke certificates nahi the. Office ne entries accept ki, lekin continuity aur forfeiture phir bhi check ki. Trap: deemed verified ka matlab forfeiture check chhodna nahi hai. Yaad rakhiye: death case mein poori book, unverified service deemed verified, par forfeiture check banta rahega.

Riya poochhti hai. Death case mein kitne mahine ke emoluments dekhe jaate hain, aur retirement se kya farq hai? Emoluments sirf ek saal ke dekhe jaate hain, death ya disappearance se pehle ke. Agar servant us din extraordinary leave par tha, to EOL shuru hone se pehle ka ek saal dekha jaata hai. Aur poora determination ek mahine mein khatam hona chahiye — intimation milne ke ek mahine ke andar. Yahan clock intimation se chalta hai, claim se nahi. Rule 74 mein clock claim se chalta hai. Comparison yaad rakhiye. Death mein ek saal ke emoluments aur ek mahina. Retirement mein chaubees mahine ke emoluments verify hote hain, aur stages retirement se aath mahine pehle khatam hote hain. Esha ki death bees March do hazaar chhabbis ko hui, to March do hazaar pachees se ek saal ke emoluments dekhe jaayenge. Agar woh January se EOL par hoti, to EOL se pehle se ginte. Trap: retirement ke chaubees mahine death case mein mat le jaaiye. Yaad rakhiye: death mein ek saal ke emoluments, ek mahine mein faisla. Retirement mein chaubees mahine verify hote hain.

Riya poochhti hai. Agar marhoom ki service book theek se maintain hi nahi hui thi, to kya hota hai? Rule 73 ka pehla sub-rule ek achha principle deta hai — aisa koi case nahi hona chahiye jahan service book theek se maintain na hui ho. Yeh office ki duty hai, family ki galti nahi. Family pension ka amount aur period Rule 50 ke sub-rule do ke hisaab se tay hota hai, death ki intimation ke ek mahine ke andar. Yahan service book ki kharabi family pension ko rok nahi sakti. Gratuity ke liye unverified service pay bills, acquittance rolls, last pay certificate aur April ki pay slip se verify hoti hai. Doosre office ki service ho to wahan reference jaata hai. Aur Rule 73(3) bachav deta hai — poori service turant verify na ho, to gratuity last verified spell par provisionally tay hoti hai, Rule 75(7) ke hisaab se. Family ko intezaar mein nahi chhoda jaata. Yaad rakhiye: Rule 73 office ki kharab record-keeping ka ilaaj hai — family ka nuksaan nahi.

Riya poochhti hai. Doosre office ko reply ke liye kitna time milta hai, aur chup rehne par ya kuch prove na hone par kya hota hai? Doosre office ko reference jaata hai, aur usko ek mahine ke andar verify karke certificate bhejna hota hai. Provison bhi yaad rakhiye — jo period verify ho hi nahi sakta, woh saath hi referring office ko batana hota hai. Agar time par jawab nahi aaya, to woh period pension ke liye deemed qualified ho jaata hai. Aur agar kisi ne non-qualifying period batana hi nahi bataya, to Secretary of the Ministry responsibility fix karta hai. Aakhri limb: har possible effort kiya jaaye. Jo phir bhi verify nahi ho sakta, usko ignore kiya jaata hai, aur gratuity service book ke entries par tay hoti hai. Bilal ke file mein do saal ka gap tha. Doosre office ne ek mahine mein reply diya, aur jo prove nahi hua woh entries par chala gaya. Trap: yahan ek mahina hai, do mahine nahi. Yaad rakhiye: reply ek mahine mein, chuppi matlab qualifying, Secretary blame fix karta hai, aur jo prove na ho woh ignore.

Riya poochhti hai. Head of Office case Accounts Officer ko kaise bhejta hai, aur clock kab se chalta hai? Claim milne ke baad Head of Office Form 11 bharta hai, saath mein Format 10 covering letter, Format 9 undertaking, aur up-to-date service book. Yeh sab Accounts Officer ko ek mahine ke andar jaana chahiye — claim se gin kar, death se nahi. Do reliefs. Kisi family member ka naam Form 4 ya records mein nahi hai, sirf isliye claim reject nahi hota, agar Head of Office baaki tarah se satisfied hai. Aur office ko Format 10, Form 10 aur Form 11 ki ek-ek copy apne paas rakhni hoti hai. Gratuity ka kuch hissa roka jaata hai — jo dues abhi assess nahi hue, aur margin ke liye. Lekin yeh hold-back gratuity ke das percent se zyada nahi ho sakta. Roka jaata hai, cheena nahi jaata. Claim das September ko aayi, to case das October tak Accounts Officer ko jaana chahiye. Gratuity aath lakh ho to zyada se zyada assi hazaar roki ja sakti hai. Trap: clock claim se shuru hota hai, aur das percent ek ceiling hai. Yaad rakhiye: Rule 74 ka clock claim se chalta hai, aur hold-back das percent se zyada nahi.

Riya poochhti hai. Final pension order banne se pehle family ko paisa kab shuru mil sakta hai? Family ko paisa kab shuru milta hai? Claim milne ke pandrah din ke andar, agar eligibility par satisfaction hai, Head of Office provisional family pension sanction karta hai — maximum se zyada nahi. Sanction letter ki copy Accounts Officer ko jaati hai. Drawing ke baad payment turant hota hai, arrears sameth. Yeh establishment ki pay aur allowances ki tarah draw hota hai, isliye family ko final order ka lamba intezaar nahi karna padta. Provisional family pension chhe mahine chalti hai — death ke doosre din se. Agar Rule 76 ke proviso se extension mila to zyada. Period khatam hone par Head of Office Accounts Officer ko batata hai. Bilal ki death ek October ko, claim saat October ko. Pandrah din se doosri October tak sanction, aur payment do October se chhe mahine. Trap: pandrah din claim se, chhe mahine death ke doosre din se. Yaad rakhiye: pandrah din claim se, chhe mahine death ke doosre din se.

Riya poochhti hai. Rule 75 mein death gratuity ka kya hota hai, aur Rule 62 se comparison kaise karein? Rule 74 ke tahat case Accounts Officer ko jaane ke baad, Head of Office poora sau percent gratuity draw karta hai. Sanction letter mein likha hota hai ki kitna due gratuity se recoverable hai, aur wahi amount minus karke draw hota hai. Agar poori service verify nahi hui, to gratuity Rule 45 ke clause ke hisaab se provisionally tay hoti hai — jo spell death se pehle verify hui. Rule 73(1) ke bawajood yeh raasta khula hai. Form 9 ka claim aa gaya to provisional gratuity death ki intimation ke ek mahine ke andar authorize hoti hai. Final gratuity teen mahine mein, aur balance beneficiaries ko. Payment hone par Accounts Officer ko batana hota hai. Retirement wale Rule 62 se compare kijiye: wahan sau percent provisional pension, aur gratuity mein se das percent roka jaata hai. Rule 75 death case ka jawab hai — pandrah din, chhe mahine. Dono mein drawing establishment pay jaisi hoti hai. Yaad rakhiye: Rule 75 mein aath sub-rules, sau percent gratuity, aur final gratuity teen mahine mein.

Riya poochhti hai. Accounts Officer case ka kya karta hai, aur provisional pension ka extension kaun kar sakta hai? Case Accounts Officer ko milta hai, aur woh ek mahine ke andar checks lagakar Form 11 ke Part II ka Section I bharta hai. Emoluments sirf ek saal ke verify hote hain — death ya disappearance se pehle ke. Agar Accounts Officer time par assess nahi kar paata, to chup nahi baithta. Woh Head of Office ko likhta hai ki provisional family pension aage chalao, aur kitne period tak — yeh proviso ka kaam hai. Extension apne aap nahi hoti. Head of Office case Head of Department ke paas bhejta hai, approval milti hai, phir naya sanction issue hota hai. Yani faisla Head of Department ka hai, Head of Office ka nahi. Case paanch November ko Accounts Officer ko mila, to Part II Section I paanch December tak bharna hai. Der ho rahi ho to Head of Department se approval. Trap: is jawab mein Head of Office likhna galat hai. Yaad rakhiye: Accounts Officer ko ek mahina, aur extension Head of Department approve karta hai.

Riya poochhti hai. Rule 76(3) PPO ke liye kaunsi dates aur clocks tay karta hai? PPO ek mahine ke andar — family pension case milne ke baad. Aur Rule 75 wali provisional family pension band hone ke doosre din se regular family pension effective hoti hai. PPO mein do dates likhi jaati hain: kab tak provisional family pension Head of Office se milti rahegi, aur kab se Pension Disbursing Authority payment karegi. Yeh dates CPAO aur PDA ka time jodkar tay hoti hain. Provisional period ke arrears Accounts Officer authorize karta hai, aur payment Head of Office karta hai. Note: Rule 81(2) mein sub-rule do likha hai, jo print ki galti lagti hai — clause 76(3)(b) hi sahi pointer hai. Missing servant ke liye start date teen mein se latest hoti hai: sanctioned leave ka end, pay milne ka end, ya police report ki date. Aur payment police report se chhe mahine se pehle nahi. Trap: earliest date mat chuniye. Yaad rakhiye: PPO ek mahine mein, PPO par do dates, missing mein teen mein se latest date, aur chhe mahine ka wait.

Riya poochhti hai. Rule 76 ke baaki sub-rules kya kehte hain, aur do hazaar baees ke amendment ne kya theek kiya? PPO mein permanently disabled child, dependent parents aur disabled siblings ke naam tabhi aate hain jab unse pehle koi eligible na ho. Rule 50 ki priority PPO ke text mein utar aati hai. Balance gratuity ka hisaab Accounts Officer karta hai — outstanding dues adjust karke — aur Head of Office ko batata hai ki jinko provisional gratuity mili, unko yeh balance de. Missing case mein gratuity ek mahine mein decide hoti hai, par payment police report se chhe mahine baad. PPO issue hone ki baat Accounts Officer Head of Office ko batata hai aur faltu documents wapas karta hai. Yeh clause do hazaar baees ke amendment se (5A) ban gaya — pehle do sub-rules dono (5) number par the. Excess provisional family pension gratuity se adjust hoti hai, warna aage ki pension se installments mein. Excess provisional gratuity wapas nahi maangi jaati, par Head of Department responsibility fix karta hai. Numbering par mat ladaiye — clause padhiye. Yaad rakhiye: Rule 76 mein (5) ke baad (5A), phir (6), (7), (8). Excess pension recover, excess gratuity refund nahi.

Riya poochhti hai. Death ke baad sarkari housing ke dues kaise handle hote hain, aur kaun kisko kya bhejta hai? Quarter wale case mein sarkari housing ke dues ka alag hisaab hai. Head of Office saat din mein Directorate of Estates ko details bhejta hai aur No Demand Certificate maangta hai — taaki family pension aur gratuity late na hon. Do jagah yeh baat aati hai, Rule 71(4) aur Rule 77(1)(ii) — death se pehle ka licence fee maaf, aur family quarter rakhe to death ke mahine plus teen mahine ka fee nahi. Damages phir bhi recover honge. Clause teen ka matlab: jo licence fee Head of Office ne Directorate of Estates ko batayi, woh gratuity se recover karta hai. Yani reporting aur recovery ka link yahin judta hai. Clause chaar ek limit khada karta hai: concessional period ke baad ka fee recover karna Directorate of Estates ki zimmedari hai, Head of Office ka kaam nahi. Trap: office ko har cheez ka collector mat samajhiye. Yaad rakhiye: Directorate ko saat din, waiver Rule 71(4) jaisa, aur clause (iii) mein reported fee gratuity se recover.

Riya poochhti hai. Baaki dues kaise report aur recover hote hain, aur family ko do baar payment se kaun bachata hai? Directorate of Estates ko ek mahine mein batana hota hai ki licence fee ke alawa koi due hai ya nahi. Tab tak Head of Office death gratuity ka das percent rok kar rakhta hai. Agar jawab nahi aaya, ya Directorate kehti hai ki assess nahi kar sakti, to maan liya jaata hai ki kuch recoverable nahi tha — aur roka hua amount family ko de diya jaata hai. Dues report ho jaayein to Head of Office acquittance rolls se check karta hai ki woh pehle pay se kata tha ya nahi. Agar kata tha, to woh pay bills Directorate ko dikhata hai — taaki family do baar na bhare. Bachi hui dues roke hue amount se adjust hoti hain, balance wapas. Baad mein aayi dues dearness relief se recover ho sakti hain, bina consent ke, aur tab tak DR band. Aur Rule 67 wali doosri dues pandrah din mein. Yaad rakhiye: Rule 77(1) mein das clauses, das percent roka jaata hai, aur acquittance rolls se double recovery rukti hai.

Riya poochhti hai. Agar servant deputation par death ya missing ho jaaye, to kaun Head of Office case chalayega? Deputation par death ya disappearance ho, to kaun kaam karega? Rule 78 kehta hai — doosre Central Department mein deputation ho to borrowing Department ka Head of Office poora case chalayega. Lekin State Government ya foreign service ki deputation ho to lambi line kaam karti hai — jis Head of Office ya cadre authority ne deputation sanction ki thi, wahi family pension aur gratuity authorize karega. Rule 78 death aur disappearance, dono cover karta hai. Rule 64 retirement ka case dekhta hai, isliye missing limb wahan banti nahi. Yaad rakhiye, yeh allocation rule hai — kaun, kahan se. Charu doosre Central Department mein deputation par thi aur wahan unki death hui — case borrowing Department ka. State deputation hoti to cadre authority karti. Trap: Central mein borrowing, State ya foreign mein lending. Yaad rakhiye: Central deputation mein borrowing side, State ya foreign mein lending side, aur missing bhi cover hai.

Riya poochhti hai. Retirement aur death case mein timing aur evidence ka farq side by side kya hai? Retirement case ek saal pehle shuru hota hai, ya retirement se pehle ki leave ke din se. Death case death ki khabar par shuru hota hai. Isliye dono ki speed aur sequence alag hoti hai. Service mein death case ka bada relief: unverified service deemed verified, aur emoluments sirf ek saal ke. Retirement mein chaubees mahine ke emoluments verify hote hain. Forfeiture check dono mein rehta hai. Retirement mein PPO do mahine pehle aa jaata hai, warna paintalis din. Death mein provisional family pension pandrah din mein, chhe mahine ke liye, aur final PPO ek mahine mein. Housing dues ka farq dekhiye. Retirement mein aakhri aath mahine ka fee pay se, aur Directorate ko do mahine. Death mein purana fee maaf, letter saat din, jawab ek mahina. Trap: retirement ke numbers death case mein mat le jaaiye. Yaad rakhiye: retirement chaubees mahine, Directorate do mahine, aath mahine. Death ek saal, ek mahina, saat din.

Riya poochhti hai. Poora death-in-service route order mein bataiye, har step ki time limit ke saath. Poora death case chaar step ka chain hai. Step one: Head of Office — kya payable hai, letters, Directorate ko saat din, aur ek mahine mein service aur emoluments ka determination. Step two: case Accounts Officer ko ek mahine mein claim se, gratuity ka das percent se zyada hold-back nahi, aur provisional family pension pandrah din mein claim se. Step three: Accounts Officer ka Form 11 Part II ek mahine mein, PPO ek mahine mein, aur extension chahiye to Head of Department ki approval. Step four: CPAO ko file ek mahine mein, Special Seal das din mein, PDA payment pandrah din mein. Trap: har clock ka start point alag hai — intimation, claim, aur death ke doosre din. Yaad rakhiye: khabar, phir claim, phir Accounts Officer, phir seal. Har clock ka start point alag hai.

Riya poochhti hai. Pensioner ki death hui. Agar widow ka naam PPO mein already hai to kya hota hai, aur kitni jaldi? Ab pensioner ki death ka chapter. Trigger teen hain: pensioner ki death ya disappearance, aur family pensioner ki death, disappearance ya ineligibility. Head of Office dekhta hai family pension, residuary gratuity, ya dono banti hai. Agar widow ya widower PPO mein already named hai, to naya sanction nahi chahiye. PPO jo kehta hai wahi milta hai, pensioner ki death ke doosre din se, aur PDA ek mahine mein payment shuru karta hai. Claim Form 12 mein hota hai, saath mein death certificate ki copy aur Format 9 undertaking. Disabled child, dependent parents, disabled siblings — jo PPO mein naam hain, unka bhi yahi raasta hai. Bilal ki death teen March ko, widow PPO mein thi, claim Form 12 se. Payment chaar March se, bina naye sanction ke. Trap: PPO wali widow ko Form 10 aur Format 13 ke raaste mat bhejiye. Yaad rakhiye: naam PPO mein ho to Form 12, PDA payment, naya sanction nahi, aur death ke doosre din se.

Riya poochhti hai. Agar PPO mein kisi ka naam nahi hai, ya pensioner missing hai, to kya karein? PPO mein kisi ka naam nahi, ya Head of Office ko lagta hai ki koi doosra eligible hai — to woh Form 10 claim milne ke ek mahine ke andar Format 13 mein sanction karta hai. Isme woh member bhi aata hai jo retirement ke baad family member bana. Missing pensioner ke liye Rule 51 ke sub-rule do aur teen lagte hain. Letter Format 12, claim Form 10, saath mein police report, untraced report, Format 8 bond aur Format 9. Missing pensioner ke do hi date hain: jis din tak pension paid hui uske doosre din, ya police report ki date — jo baad mein aaye. Payment police report se chhe mahine se pehle nahi. Claim sirf isliye reject nahi hota ki naam Form 4 mein nahi hai. Aur widow ke alawa koi claim kare to Rule 50 ke sub-rule bara ke clause be ke documents lagte hain. Trap: missing servant ki teen date, missing pensioner ki do. Yaad rakhiye: missing pensioner ki do date, missing servant ki teen, aur police report se chhe mahine.

Riya poochhti hai. Agar widow remarriage kar leti hai, aur Rule 79 ke sub-rule paanch aur chhe kya kehte hain? Remarriage par pension seedha band nahi hoti. Widow apne eligible minor children ke liye draw kar sakti hai, lekin tab tak jab tak woh unki guardian hai. Guardian na rahe to legal guardian claim karega. Declaration Form 10 ke saath jaata hai. Aur haan, jo child pehle se majority age cross kar chuka hai aur eligible hai, usko remarriage ke baad seedha pension milti hai — yeh clause (c) hai. Majboori wale cases ke liye Rule 79(5): minor, ya mental disorder, disability ya mental retardation wale person ke liye guardian Form 10 mein claim kar sakta hai. Aur Rule 79(6): retired servant ki death par residuary gratuity Rule 45 ke sub-rule do ke tahat, eligible persons ke Form 13 claims par Head of Office sanction karta hai. Rule 79 mein chhe sub-rules hain — chaar nahi. Yaad rakhiye: remarriage automatic stop nahi, Rule 79 mein chhe sub-rules, aur Form 13 Format 13 nahi.

Riya poochhti hai. Family pension sanction hone ke baad teen clock kya hain, aur interest kab banta hai? Rule 79 ka sanction milne ke baad teen clock chalti hain. Accounts Officer ek mahine mein authorize karta hai, CPAO ko file ek mahine mein jaati hai, aur Special Seal das din mein. Phir Pension Disbursing Authority pandrah din mein payment shuru karti hai — matlab aakhri teen steps mein lagbhag pachpan din. Aur yeh timelines CGA aur CPAO ke orders ke hisaab se hoti hain. Pehla proviso interest ka hai. Gratuity administrative lapse se late hui to interest milta hai — lekin sirf claim ke teen mahine ke baad wali deri par. Responsibility Rule 65 ke tahat fix hoti hai. Doosra proviso missing cases ka hai: PPO par likha jaata hai ki pension kab tak paid hui, aur police report se chhe mahine pehle payment nahi. Claim ek March ko to interest ek June ke baad ki deri par. Yaad rakhiye: ek mahina, das din, pandrah din. Interest sirf claim ke teen mahine ke baad ki deri par.

Riya poochhti hai. Agar retired servant ne forms bhare hi nahi aur death ho gayi, to kya hota hai? Ek khaas case: pensioner retire hone ke baad, forms bhare bina hi mar gaya. Tab bhi family ko paisa milta hai. Rule 80(5)(a) kehta hai spouse, ya spouse na ho to koi eligible member, Form 10 ke saath Form 4 aur Format 9 de. Agar koi family pension ke liye eligible hi nahi hai, to gratuity nominee Form 10 ki jagah Form 6-A de sakta hai, apne bank details ke saath. Do hazaar chaubis ke amendment ke baad Form 6 nahi, Form 6-A likhiye. Head of Office Form 7 bharta hai aur note karta hai ki retiree ne Form 6-A nahi diya tha. Family pension ka claim ho to Format 13 sanction bhi jaata hai. File Accounts Officer ko Format 10 letter ke saath jaati hai. Accounts Officer Part II of PPO mein pension, gratuity aur family pension authorize karta hai, aur Head of Office ko retirement ke doosre din se death tak ke arrears dene ka haq deta hai. Phir wahi das din, pandrah din ka chain. Yaad rakhiye: 80(5) mein purana form set ya Form 6-A. Form 6 ab Form 6-A hai.

Riya poochhti hai. Pension aur family pension kis din se shuru hoti hai, aur death ka din paid hai ya nahi? Rule 81 batata hai ki pension kab se banti hai. Family pension ke alawa pension us din se jab servant establishment se hat jaata hai — Rule 8 ke power ke subject. Family pension death ke doosre din se — servant ho ya pensioner. Aur family pensioner ki death ya ineligibility ho to uske doosre din se. Rule 79(3)(iv) missing case ki date batata hai. Aur ek insaani detail: pension, family pension sameth, us din ke liye bhi payable hai jab recipient ki death hoti hai. Aakhri din poora milta hai, aadha din kaatne ka koi rule nahi. Charu ki death bara August ko: unki pension bara August ke liye poori, aur family pension terah August se. Trap: family pension death ke din se shuru karna galat hai. Aur Rule 70(2) bilkul alag sawaal hai. Yaad rakhiye: pension establishment se hatne ke din se, family pension death ke doosre din se, aur death ka din paid.

Riya poochhti hai. Pension kis currency mein, kahan, aur mahine ki kis tareekh ko milti hai — March sameth? Rule 82 chhota hai par sakht: saari pensions aur gratuities rupees mein, aur sirf India mein. Currency ya desh mein koi flexibility nahi. Rule 83(1): gratuity lump sum mein di jaati hai, jab tak rules kuch aur na kahein. Installments default nahi hain. Rule 83(2): mahine ki pension us mahine ke last working day ko ya uske baad di jaati hai. March ka exception yaad rakhiye — March ki pension April ke pehle working day par ya uske baad. Bilal tees June do hazaar chhabbis ko retire hue, to pension ek July se, aur pehla payment July ka. March do hazaar sattais ki pension April ke pehle working day se. Trap: pehli pension June ki batana galat hai. Yaad rakhiye: rupees, India mein; gratuity lump sum; pension month-end par; March ki pension April mein.

Riya poochhti hai. Rule 84 khud kuch nahi kehta lagta. Kaunse doosre rules isko chalate hain? Rule 84 khud rights nahi banata — woh batata hai kaunse doosre rules lagenge. Treasury Rules payment ki procedure ke liye aate hain, chaar cheezon mein: gratuity, pension, ek saal se zyada undrawn pension, aur dead pensioner ki pension. Doosra: CCS Commutation of Pension Rules 1981 — commutation, commuted value ka payment, aur period khatam hone par restoration. Yani unnis sau ikkasi ke rules, Rule 84(2) ke through. Teesra: Payment of Arrears of Pension Nominations Rules 1983 — pensioner ki death ke baad arrears kaun lega. Retirees ke liye nomination ab Form 6-A mein aati hai; Form A sirf baad ki ya badli hui nomination ke liye. Pattern yaad rakhiye: kaun aur kaunsa instrument poochhe to allocation rule, kitna aur kab se poochhe to substantive rule. Commutation ke percentage Rule 84 mein dhoondhna bekaar hai. Yaad rakhiye: Rule 84 matlab Treasury Rules, Commutation 1981 aur Arrears Nominations 1983 — teen sub-rules.

Riya poochhti hai. Rules ki interpretation par doubt ho to kaun settle karta hai, kaun relax kar sakta hai, aur case kaise refer hota hai? Rule 85: rules ki interpretation par doubt ho to khud decide nahi karte. Woh Government ko refer hota hai — DoPPW ya DoPT ko, is baat par depend karta hai ki rule kis subject ka hai. Rule 86: agar kisi rule ke chalne se kisi ek case mein undue hardship hoti hai, to Ministry ya Department order se us requirement ko relax kar sakti hai — reasons likhkar, aur just aur equitable tarike se. Lekin proviso sakht hai: aisa order DoPPW ya DoPT ki concurrence ke bina nahi ho sakta. Yani relaxation ka power hai, par akela istemaal nahi. Chobis October do hazaar pachees ka Office Memorandum batata hai referral kaise bhejein: pehle case examine karo, tentative conclusion banao, phir specific rule likho, Secretary ki approval se, preferably e-File par. Bina examination referral bhejna galat hai. Yaad rakhiye: pehle examine kijiye, tentative conclusion banaiye, phir refer kijiye. Rules 85 aur 86 ka text ab verified hai.

Riya poochhti hai. Rule 87 kya repeal karta hai, purane papers ka kya hota hai, aur pending cases kahan jaate hain? Rule 87(1) purane rules ko repeal karta hai — har rule, regulation ya order, Office Memorandum sameth, jisme unnis sau bahattar ke Pension Rules example ke taur par diye hain. Lekin repeal partial hai: sirf utni baat tak, jitni in rules mein covered hai. Savings (a): purane rules ke tahat ki gayi nomination, family details ka form, aur pension ki formal application — teeno naye rules ke tahat ki hui maani jaati hain. Savings (b): jo cheez purane rule ke tahat honi chahiye thi par nahi hui, woh ab in rules ke hisaab se hogi. Yani documents aage chalte hain. Savings (c), (d), (e): commencement se pehle retire hue servant ka pending case, aur deceased servant ya pensioner ke gratuity aur family pension ke pending cases — purane rule se decide honge, jaise naye rules bane hi na hon. Baaki jo hua, woh naye rules ke tahat hua maana jaayega. Yaad rakhiye: documents aage, pending cases peeche. Rule 87 ka poora text ab verified hai.

Riya poochhti hai. Do hazaar pachees ke Office Memoranda claim aur payment stages ke liye kya jodte hain, aur kya nahi badalte? Unnees September do hazaar pachees ki comprehensive guidelines administrative calendar deti hain. Welfare Officer, yani Pension Mitra, har retiring employee ke saath hota hai, aur pensioner ki death par dependents ko documents mein help karta hai. Calendar ke stages nau, das-A, das-B aur gyarah hain — nau, das, gyarah, baarah nahi. Stage nau mein PAO PPO bhejta hai, das-A mein CPAO seal, das-B mein half copy, gyarah mein credit. Tees October do hazaar pachees ka Office Memorandum do baatein kehta hai: death ki date completed working day maani jaayegi, aur claim us date par lagne wale rules se chalega. Note: family pension ka doosre din se shuru hona Rule 81(2) hai, is memorandum ka bayaan nahi. Layer alag rakhiye: rule ka clock kanoon hai, calendar administrative target hai. Welfare Officer ki madad time limit badha nahi sakti. Trap: stage baarah quote karna, ya calendar ko Rule 80 se replace karna. Yaad rakhiye: calendar ke stages nau, das-A, das-B, gyarah administrative hain. Rule 80 ka clock kanoon hai.

Riya poochhti hai. Kaunse Gazette amendments Rules 71 se 87 ko chhoote hain, aur koi naya change hai kya? Chaar notifications dekhiye. G.S.R. aath sau adsath E ne rules banaaye, saat sau sattar E ne Rule 76 ka doosra paanch (5A) kiya, chaar sau das E ne Form 6 ko Form 6-A kiya, aur teen sau chalees E ne sirf Rule 37 ko chhua. Rule 71 se 87 mein chaar sau das E ke baad, ikkees October do hazaar chhabbis tak, koi amendment nahi mila. Yeh negative result sirf padhe gaye pages tak limited hai — isliye Office Memorandum check karna aadat banaiye. Dynamic figures: dearness relief saath percent ek January do hazaar chhabbis se, aur GPF saat point ek percent October se December do hazaar chhabbis tak. Dono badalte hain — rule quote kijiye, figure memorandum se lijiye. Aur ek padhne wali baat: loose reproductions Rule 76 ke baad wale clauses ko chhe se nau tak print karte hain, kyunki woh duplicate paanch ko collapse kar dete hain. Sahi citation paanch, paanch-A, chhe, saat, aath hai. Yaad rakhiye: Rules 71 se 87 ko sirf 770(E) aur 410(E) ne chhua. Dearness relief aur GPF badalte hain — memorandum dekhiye.

Riya poochhti hai. Batch ko key numbers, top traps aur currency note ke saath band karein? Numbers ek saath. Saat din Directorate ko, ek saal ke emoluments, ek mahina determination, pandrah din provisional family pension, chhe mahine, aur missing case mein police report se chhe mahine. Rule 80 ka chain: ek mahina, das din, pandrah din. Interest claim ke teen mahine ke baad. Aur Rule 83: pension month-end par, March ki pension April mein. Top traps: clock ke start point alag, damages maaf nahi, missing servant ki teen date aur pensioner ki do, Form 6 ab 6-A, Format 13 aur Form 13 alag, aur purane pending cases unnis sau bahattar ke rules mein. Currency: chaar sau das E tak sab kuch verified, Rules 71 se 87 ka text padha gaya, aur dearness relief aur GPF jaise figures har baar Office Memorandum se check kijiye. Agla batch: decision tree, forms, aur master deadlines. Yaad rakhiye: ek saal, pandrah din aur chhe mahine, phir ek mahina, das din, pandrah din. Agla Batch 7.
